Title: Prediction of hERG channel blockers with directed message passing neural networks
Description: Predicts blockade of the hERG potassium channel, the off-target most commonly responsible for cardiac safety failures. Shan and colleagues applied a directed message-passing neural network, which propagates information along bonds rather than atoms and so distinguishes the direction a substructure is traversed. Training used Cai's collection of 7,889 compounds with blockers set at an IC50 of 10 uM, reaching AUC-ROC values around 0.95 in five-fold cross-validation. The checkpoint served here is the plain network, without the closed-source MOE descriptors behind the authors' best results.
Interpretation: Probability of hERG potassium channel blockade, with blockers labelled from IC50 values below 10 uM.
